wire.headline: Northbridge Railways to raise fares by 12% as shares dip
sentences: Northbridge Railways has announced a 12% fare increase that becomes effective on 4 November.
The company cited a 310m GBP deficit in its 2023 operating accounts as the reason for the decision.
The price hike applies to all standard class tickets across the network.
CEO Julian Thorne called the fare hike 'essential for network stability'.
Shares of Northbridge Railways dropped 4.5% in pre-market trading following the announcement.
The regulatory body Ofcom is scheduled to review the company's compliance by March 2027.
